title: Other non-metal waste or scrap

review.classification: UN October 2026 workbook rows 1907 and 514 separate 39290 (HS 2525.30 and 2621) from the mineral leaf 16390 (including 2525.10 and 2525.20). WCO heading 25.25 distinguishes mica waste from crude or rifted material, sheets and powder. Heading 68.14 provides the adjacent worked-mica article boundary. A piece suitable for normal sheet use is not accepted as scrap solely because its physical dimensions are smaller.
review.primary_evidence: USGS Professional Paper 225 describes both the workshop cuttings and their commercialization. MICAMAFCO separately describes factory scrap or cuttings from natural sheet fabrication and mine scrap. Its internally inconsistent size conversions, quality descriptions and suggested packaging weights supply no lot measurements. The controller independently read Indian Bureau of Mines §5.4 distinguishing unbonded mechanical fabrication scrap, mine dressing and bonded micanite. The author did not acquire that full original. Site and purchaser statements are still needed to establish actual unground, unpackaged trade.
review.measurement: The author repaired a cross-period omission. Separate pre-split unallocated WIP from the per-exchange burden vector for scrap after joint fabrication. At the common generation point use actual joint output and compatible values, then retain source and dedicated handling burdens in each lot until it is handed over or transferred to another recorded destination. Raw X/Q ratios are physical audit evidence; the product inventory takes only the separately attributed release vector divided once by Q. A period producing stock with zero handover then one releasing it without new fabrication must preserve original sheet, power and other components. Document non-saleable loss treatment, avoid treating a balance discrepancy as an air release, and keep free moisture separate from structural water.
review.native_records: Ten exchange identities remain unbound. The English Mica Product has source CPC 16390 and Chinese name mica paper. The generic Offcut Waste has Chinese name wood offcut and source CPC 39282. Neither identifies the unground natural muscovite workshop scrap Product. Mass/kg is supported by immutable archive records. Separate Energy and Units of energy records verify metering units without determining the supplier electricity flow or its native reference property.
review.readiness: Ten cards per language. Independent pcr:check performed 53 checks, zero skipped, seven warnings. Candidate/authored, Chinese aligned. Source-specific purchases, prices, contamination and moisture samples, transfer records, provider identities, scientific and formal translation review remain open.

sources.role: Heading 68.14, worked mica or its articles.

Supplier describes a distinct market for factory scrap; numerical conversions not adopted.

Sections 7.9.2 and 7.9.3, conditional allocation for shared production.
